name: io.github.pufferfishllc3548-cmd/doc2json
title: doc2json
description: Convert a PDF or DOCX text layer into JSON, Markdown, and tables. $0.02 USDC/call via x402 on Base.

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Convert a user-supplied PDF or DOCX into structured JSON, Markdown, and tables. v1 reads a digital text layer only; scanned PDFs and images are rejected until OCR is added. Price is 0.02 USDC per successful call on Base.

source_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PDF or DOCX. Do not send both this and content_base64.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF or DOCX bytes. Prefer this for private documents.

filename.description: Original filename, used to help detect type.

media_type.description: Optional MIME type, for example application/pdf.

output.description: Result shape. Default is both JSON fields and Markdown.

tools.name: price_info
tools.description: Free tool: current price, network, payTo, and v1 limits. Does not convert a document.
